exact_blocks.planner_readme:
Read your own planner items with `canvaspilot planner --start-date 2026-10-08 --end-date 2026-10-15`.
The [planner CLI guide](docs/planner-cli.md) explains native date filters,
personal notes, supplied completion metadata and complete-list error behavior.
The command uses the existing planner API and does not change any planner state.

page_export.parser:
page_export = sub.add_parser(
        "export-pages", help="Save explicitly selected course pages to a new offline HTML reading packet"
    )
    add_common(page_export)
    page_export.add_argument("course_id", help="Positive numeric Canvas course ID")
    page_export.add_argument("pages", nargs="+", help="Page URL locators, or page_id:ID for an explicit numeric ID")
    page_export.add_argument("--out", required=True, type=Path, help="New HTML file; existing paths are protected")
page_export.readme:
To take explicitly selected course pages offline, use
`canvaspilot export-pages 42 course-introduction week-two-reading --out reading.html`.
The [page export guide](docs/page-export.md) explains numeric page IDs, the inert
original-source record, selection limits and protection of existing output.

method: Use exact UTF-8 source fetched from GitHub. Assert each block occurs once before removal. Remove only the original planner blocks to recover current native source. Independently remove the exact new page-export blocks from both native and composed source to recover their respective prior versions. Compare the unchanged API bodies. Full published tree preservation is qualified separately.

initial_probe.cause: The first page-export extractor omitted the leading newline included in the accepted native additions. The full candidate already preserved current native bytes; correcting only the reverse-check block to include that newline made all seven checks pass.
initial_probe.execution_scope: Pure text composition check; no Python or product child ran.

independent.source: Direct parent collaboration message; parent independently fetched both exact GitHub source bodies.
independent.observation: Deleting the same two exact original planner blocks from candidate source reproduces the complete native CLI byte for byte.
independent.limits: No repeated source receiver or full package execution. The original 123-condition packet remains immutable; final full-package acceptance is the actual hosted gate on the new composition.

limits: No new product behavior, API/client/helper/dependency/workflow change is introduced.
The current native page-export parser and dispatch are separate branches with lazy page-export imports. All pre-existing native bytes survive removal of the planner additions.
The previous nine-child independent 123-condition result stays pinned to original df01 source; the prior three one-child composition results stay pinned to their executed source.
No extra local product receiver was run for this byte-exact additive composition. The new head must pass the unchanged hosted package/Ruff/pytest gate before merge.
No live Canvas account, API, course, student record, browser session, release or production state was used.
